newsitem.title: UK: Turkey buys 135,000 tonnes Dec gas oil-trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkey buys 135,000 tonnes Dec gas oil-trade.

text.p: Turkey's state-owned oil company Tupras has bought about 135,000 tonnes of 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil for delivery in the first half of December, traders said on Thursday.
Tupras has originally tendered for four cargoes of 25,000 tonnes each.
The awards follow the purchase of 225,000 tonnes in November.
Traders said Onyx was awarded about 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes at fob high +$10.50 cif Samsun. Onyx would also supply two cargoes of about 25,000 each at fob high +$11.50 cif Tutunciflik, traders said.

Total would supply 25,000 tonnes at fob high +$13.75 cif Mersin, Tempotrade would supply a cargo at fob high +$13.68 cif Iskanderun and Penta would supply a cargo at fob Med mean +$2 fob Bulgaria, the traders added.
